title: UV-vis absorption peak shift across annealing temperatures
what: red shift of the 400 °C sample's peak (nm), or its peak position

reader_questions.question: By how many nm does the 400 °C sample's absorption peak shift relative to the unannealed sample?
reader_questions.expected: Red-shifted by +25 nm (peak at ~545 nm vs ~520 nm reference).

reader_questions.question: What wavelengths and resolution were measured?
reader_questions.expected: 400–700 nm in 5 nm steps across three samples.

reader_questions.question: Did the 200 °C anneal shift the peak?
reader_questions.expected: No meaningful shift at 200 °C; the red shift only appears at 400 °C.
